text:
Evan L: quick sync - launching 'bench-bites' (3x mini tutorials + one benchmark recipe) next week. targets: devs who want runnable perf numbers and a tiny tutorial flow. low-friction.
Priya N: love the name. propose assets: 3 short markdown how-tos, a single reproducible benchmark notebook, and a 60s demo clip.
Sam R: i can repo-ify the notebook into an action workflow that runs on push. will output a CSV and a small chart. ETA 72h.
Maya T: i'll write the blog + social. angle: "reproducible micro-benchmarks for inference" and include how to route traffic between Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Evan L: cadence idea: Tues AM release repo + blog, Tues PM social thread, Wed newsletter callout, Thurs office hours (15m). keep all CTAs to repo + demo.
Priya N: inbound lead capture: add a one-click feedback form in the README that sends a label "bench-bites" to marketing@redwood.com. Ops suggests HubSpot form embed.
Sam R: i'll add a static form that posts to HubSpot. also adding a lightweight badge in README that links to the survey.
Maya T: social copy draft: "Introducing Bench-Bites: tiny, reproducible inference recipes you can run in <5 mins. Each includes latency & cost guidance for common model sizes. Try the repo -> <link>" Thoughts? :loudspeaker:
Evan L: add a short benchmark headline we can reuse in tweets: e.g., "p50=95ms @128 tokens on A10G (batch=8)" — placeholder until CI run completes.
Sam R: running CI bench on g4dn.xlarge now. will ping results. small note: the workflow will tag runs with commit sha and save artifacts in /artifacts/bench-bites/<sha>/bench.csv.
ops-bot: @Sam R reminder: artifact retention set to 30 days. Use the workflow step `upload-artifact --path=artifacts/bench-bites/$GITHUB_SHA`
Priya N: creatives: need hero screenshot, 60s mp4, and a tiny GIF for tweet. Sam, can the workflow export a GIF?
Sam R: yes, adding a script to ffmpeg-export a 6s GIF from the demo. will commit assets/demo.gif.
Maya T: newsletter blurb: one paragraph + link, bullets for what devs get (repro scripts, CI, benchmark notebook). Priya can approve.
Priya N: inbound routing checklist: 1) HubSpot form + list "bench-bites", 2) Zap to create contact + tag, 3) send welcome autoresponder with repo link. Ops: who owns Zap?
Evan L: I'll set up the Zap and hand over creds to marketing ops.
Sam R: bench results: p50=142ms @128 tokens on g4dn.xlarge (no quant), batching=4; CSV uploaded at artifacts/bench-bites/abc123/bench.csv. pushing PR now.
Maya T: perfect — i'll update copy with numbers. note: include a short note about variability and how to reproduce.
Priya N: timeline recap: Fri AM - PR + assets, Fri PM - blog draft ready, Mon - publish & social, Tue - office hours.
Evan L: approved. keep it minimal so devs can fork and run quickly. when PR is merged, ops-bot can publish the demo GIF to CDN.
ops-bot: queued: on tag v0.0.1 publish demo.gif to https://cdn.redwood.com/bench-bites/v0.0.1/demo.gif
Maya T: will post social copy here for sign-off before publish.
Evan L: thanks team — let's keep this tight. share PR link and i'll schedule publish. :rocket:
